What if your AI assistant forgot your name mid-conversation? The Janitor LLM context window defines the finite information an AI can process at once. This limit directly impacts its immediate recall and ability to maintain coherent, useful interactions. Understanding the Janitor AI context window size is crucial for optimizing AI performance.
